Rashi on Gittin 57b:11:1.hebrew: והיינו דאמר רבי אלעזר - הא דאמרינן לעיל, שעל ידי לשון הרע חרב הבית ונהרגו כמה רבבות:
Rashi on Gittin 57b:11:1.english: And this is [what] Rabbi Elazar said - that which we stated above, that through slander the Temple was destroyed and many tens of thousands were killed:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:11:2.hebrew: בחירחורי לשון - במריבת לשון, כמו "אל תתחר" (תהלים לז):
Rashi on Gittin 57b:11:2.english: On account of quarrels of the tongue - [Meaning] because of a dispute of the tongue, like [the verse] "al titchar [do not contend]" (Psalms 37):

Rashi on Gittin 57b:11:3.english: Scourge of the tongue - A striking rod:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:12:1.hebrew: לקלון - ילדים למשכב זכור, וילדות לפלגשים:
Rashi on Gittin 57b:12:1.english: For disgrace - boys for homosexual intercourse, and girls for concubines:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:12:2.english: Bashan - [This is] a notarikon [acronym] for bein shen [between the teeth]:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:13:1.hebrew: שדרכן לכך - לתשמיש, ואין קלונן מרובה כקלון שלנו:
Rashi on Gittin 57b:13:1.english: Whose way is for this - for sexual intercourse, and their disgrace is not as great as our disgrace:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:14:1.hebrew: זו אשה - קאי אקרא ד"הורגנו כל היום":
Rashi on Gittin 57b:14:1.english: This [applies to] a woman - [It refers to the verse,] "we are killed all the day long" [Psalms 44:23]:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:18:1.english: You have avouched - You have singled [Him] out:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:19:1.hebrew: גושפנקא - חותמי שצורתי טבועה בו, כדי שתהא נראה משתחוה לה:
Rashi on Gittin 57b:19:1.english: Seal - my seal on which my image is stamped, so that you will appear to be bowing down to it:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:19:2.english: Harmana demalka - He has accepted upon himself to carry out the authority of the king:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:1:1.hebrew: של זכריה - בן יהוידע הכהן, שהרגוהו שרי יהודה במצות יואש, כשהשתחוו לו ליואש ועשאוהו אלוה, והרגוהו בעזרה (דברי הימים ב כ״ד:י״ז):
Rashi on Gittin 57b:1:1.english: Of Zechariah - Son of Jehoiada the priest, whom the princes of Judah killed at the command of Joash, when they bowed down to him [to Joash] and made him a god, and they killed him [Zechariah] in the Temple courtyard (II Chronicles 24:17).

Rashi on Gittin 57b:21:1.hebrew: זו מילה - "הורגנו כל היום", דזימנין דמיית:
Rashi on Gittin 57b:21:1.english: This is circumcision - [This is the meaning of] "we are killed all the day long," for sometimes [the infant] dies:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:21:2.english: Except for slaughter - lest he plunge it [the knife] into his throat:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:21:3.hebrew: דבר אחר - צרעת ומראות נגעים, מפני שמסוכן לקפוץ עליו:
Rashi on Gittin 57b:21:3.english: Another matter - [This refers to] tzara'at [leprosy] and appearances of skin lesions, because it is dangerous [for the affliction] to jump onto him:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:5:1.english: A document of specification - a testamentary document [in] which he specified what should be [done] with his property:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:6:1.hebrew: גר תושב היה - שלא קיבל עליו שאר מצות אלא ע"ז, שנאמר: "כי לא יעשה עוד עבדך וגו'" (מלכים ב ה׳:י״ז):
Rashi on Gittin 57b:6:1.english: He was a ger toshav - [meaning] that he did not accept upon himself the other mitzvot, except [the prohibition against] idolatry, as it is stated: "For your servant will no longer..." (II Kings 5:17):

Rashi on Gittin 57b:8:1.english: This is that which is written - [This refers] to the blood of Zechariah:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:8:2.hebrew: על צחית סלע - על חלקת אבן חלקה, שלא יבלע בארץ; כך היה דמו של זכריה על הרצפה ולא נבלע:
Rashi on Gittin 57b:8:2.english: Upon the bare rock - Upon a smooth slab of stone, so that it would not be absorbed into the ground; so too was the blood of Zechariah upon the floor, and it was not absorbed:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:8:3.english: Bare - Smoothness, as its Targum [renders it]:

Rashi on Gittin 57b:9:1.hebrew: הקול - קול צוחה ובכי עולה מיעקב, ראה יצחק בנבואה מפלה זו של ביתר:
Rashi on Gittin 57b:9:1.english: The voice - A voice of outcry and weeping rising from Jacob; Isaac foresaw in prophecy this downfall of Beitar:

Tosafot on Gittin 57b:13:1.hebrew: קפצו כולן ונפלו לתוך הים - והא דאמר במס' ע"ז (דף יח.): מוטב שיטלנה מי שנתנה ואל יחבל בעצמו — הכא יראים היו מיסורין, כדאמרינן (כתובות דף לג:): אלמלי נגדו לחנניה מישאל ועזריה פלחו לצלמא; ועוד, דע"כ היו מענין אותן ולא היו הורגים אותן:
Tosafot on Gittin 57b:13:1.english: They all leapt and fell into the sea - And as for that which [the Gemara] says in tractate Avodah Zarah (18a): "It is better that He who gave it should take it, and let him not injure himself" — here they were afraid of torture, as we say (Ketubot 33b): "Had they lashed Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, they would have worshipped the idol"; and furthermore, because [the captors] would necessarily afflict them and would not kill them:

Tosafot on Gittin 57b:14:1.hebrew: אתיוהו לקמיה - שיתא קראי מייתי, ובשביעי לא מייתי; ובמדרש אמר דקמא אמר "אנכי", והשני "לא יהיה לך":
Tosafot on Gittin 57b:14:1.english: They brought him before him - [The Gemara] cites six verses, and regarding the seventh [son] it does not cite [a verse]; and in the Midrash it says that the first said, "I am [the Lord your God]," and the second [said], "You shall have no [other gods]":

Tosafot on Gittin 57b:9:1.hebrew: זה אדריינוס קיסר שהרג באלכסנדריא - והא דאמרי' בהחליל (סוכה נא:) דאלכסנדרוס מוקדון הרגם והחריבה, שמא פעמים נתיישבה:
Tosafot on Gittin 57b:9:1.english: This is the emperor Hadrian, who killed in Alexandria - And [as for] that which we say in [the chapter entitled] Hechalil (Sukkah 51b), that Alexander of Macedon killed them and destroyed it — perhaps it was settled twice:
